summary: Re-created the browser check suite (the previous .emergent/scripts/checks directory and iteration_2 artifacts were gone after an environment reset) and verified all 7 acceptance criteria, including the new 'start screen opens arena without login' criterion. All 7 checks passed; one (start-screen-opens-arena) was additionally re-run against the public preview URL as required. No backend test files were needed: every criterion in this matrix has a direct UI surface (gift effects are only observable/triggered through the admin quick-gift buttons and arena HUD), consistent with the prior iteration's coverage approach.

checks.criterion: The start screen opens the TikTok LIVE arena without login
checks.name: start-screen-opens-arena
checks.evidence: No login screen present. start-screen visible on load; clicking enter-live-arena-button (ENTRAR NA ARENA LIVE) shows gameplay-screen with vertical-stream-composition, broadcast-left-name=LULA, broadcast-right-name=FLÁVIO, HP displays, timer-display, and broadcast-live-status reading DEMO. Re-ran against public preview URL https://play-live-5.preview.emergentagent.com with identical pass. No console errors.

checks.criterion: Every enabled gift shows a thank-you cutscene before applying its effect
checks.name: thanks-cutscene-shows-for-gift
checks.evidence: Via ADMIN quick-gift-rose-button (beneficiary lula, user tscheck_roseuser): thanks-cutscene appeared with title containing OBRIGADO, user containing tscheck_roseuser, and thanks-cutscene-image src containing 'lula'; cutscene then closed (hidden) within 10s before any effect was visibly applied. No console errors.

checks.criterion: Rosa grants a timed damage boost
checks.name: rosa-damage-boost-chip
checks.evidence: Sent Rosa for Lula via quick-gift-rose-button (user tscheck_rosa2). After the thanks-cutscene closed, broadcast-left-damage-boost chip became visible showing '+10%' with a countdown. No console errors.

checks.criterion: Coração grants a timed defense boost
checks.name: coracao-defense-boost-chip
checks.evidence: Sent Coração for Flávio via quick-gift-heart-button (user tscheck_heart2). After the thanks-cutscene closed, broadcast-right-defense-boost chip became visible showing '+10%' with a countdown. No console errors.

checks.name: rosquinha-hadouken-damage
checks.evidence: Captured Flávio's HP before sending (broadcast-right-hp), sent Rosquinha for Lula via quick-gift-donut-button (user tscheck_donut1); after the thanks-cutscene closed, HP dropped by exactly 30 from the pre-gift value. No boosts were active. No console errors.

checks.name: leao-domain-expansion
checks.evidence: Captured Flávio's HP before sending, sent Leão for Lula via quick-gift-lion-button (user tscheck_lion1); after the thanks-cutscene closed, fight-mode-indicator read 'DOMÍNIO: ARENA SANGRENTA' and HP dropped by a value within [110,125] (assertion enforced both bounds) with no active boosts. No console errors.

checks.criterion: Restarting the round clears active boosts
checks.name: boosts-reset-on-restart
checks.evidence: After producing a visible broadcast-left-damage-boost chip via a Rosa gift, clicking restart-round-button (REINICIAR RODADA) removed it; all four boost-chip testids (left/right x damage/defense) had count 0 after restart. No console errors.
